name: Andaz Napa
positioning: Rustic-chic boutique hotel in walkable downtown Napa, with loft rooms, terrace suites and a second-floor outdoor restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in walkable downtown Napa
Couples who want a suite with a soaking tub for two and a furnished terrace or balcony

facts.text: Andaz Napa is a boutique hotel in downtown Napa.
Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train are both within walking distance of the hotel.
Rooms are rustic-chic, with hardwood floors and deep soaking tubs.
Several rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and marble bathrooms with rain showers.
The Andaz Tower Suite has 12-foot ceilings, a separate bedroom and an oversized soaking tub for two.
The Andaz Vintner Suite has a separate bedroom, a soaking tub for two, a dual-sided glass fireplace, a dining area and a furnished terrace.
Rooms have Malin + Goetz bath toiletries.
The hotel offers exclusive hotel events and a tasting room for exploring Napa's arts, wine and culinary culture.
Mercantile Social serves farm-fresh seasonal food made with local Napa ingredients.
Andaz Farmers Table serves a farm-to-table breakfast around a communal dining table, with a Barista Bar.
The hotel is pet friendly and provides a doggy bed, two bowls and treats for dogs.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the rooms as loft-like, with hardwood floors and contemporary touches, and the location as downtown and walkable.

highlights.text: Guests can choose a loft accommodation with a sleek fireplace or a suite with a furnished terrace overlooking downtown Napa.
The Andaz Harvest Suite has a soaking tub for two and a retractable glass wall that opens to a furnished balcony.
Mercantile Terrace is a second-floor outdoor restaurant with fire pits and cabanas, where mixologists craft cocktails with ingredients native to Napa Valley and Northern California.
Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train are both within walking distance of the hotel.

considerations.text: This is a downtown hotel; San Francisco International Airport is about 60 miles away.
Self-parking is in the Clay Street Garage, directly behind the hotel.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site recreational facilities compared with resort-style properties.
